qualification.details: Public Health Expert: MBBS with Master's in Public Health (MPH) or MD (Community Medicine), or Master's Degree in Public Health. Candidates with Master's Degree in Hospital Management with relevant experience may also apply. Admin. Support: Bachelor's Degree or any other equivalent degree from a recognized University/Institution. Research Associate: Master's Degree in Public Health, Statistics, Economics, Public Policy, Social Sciences, Management, Development Studies, or any other relevant discipline from a recognized University/Institution. Data Analyst / MIS Specialist: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (B.Tech.), Master of Computer Applications (MCA), or Master's Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Applications, or an equivalent relevant discipline from a recognized University/Institution. Hospital Management Expert: Master's Degree in Health Administration, Healthcare Management, Hospital Management, or an equivalent relevant discipline from a recognized University/Institution. Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist: Master's Degree in Public Policy, Statistics, Economics, Monitoring & Evaluation, Public Health, Healthcare & Hospital Management, or an equivalent postgraduate qualification in a relevant discipline from a recognized University/Institution. Team Leader: Postgraduate Degree in Public Health, Health Systems, Health Management, Hospital Administration, Community Medicine, Public Policy, Management, Social Sciences, Development Studies, or any other relevant discipline from a recognized University.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CGG Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CGG to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CGG Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CGG to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CGG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the CGG Recruitment 2026 is 15th September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How can I apply for the CGG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications for CGG Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online through the official website or the direct application link provided in the important links section.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for CGG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the notification, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for the CGG Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Public Health Expert post?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria for the Public Health Expert post include an MBBS degree with MPH or MD (Community Medicine), or a Master's Degree in Public Health. Relevant experience may also be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for CGG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves scrutiny of applications, shortlisting based on qualifications and experience, followed by an interview and verification of original certificates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit for the CGG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for the posts. It is advisable to check the detailed notification for any specific age criteria.

faq.question: Q7. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: The CGG Recruitment 2026 is for contractual positions. Candidates should be aware of the contractual nature of the employment.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF for CGG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is usually available in the "Important Links" section of the job advertisement or on the CGG official website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located in Hyderabad, Telangana.

faq.question: Q10. What are the different posts advertised in CGG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for various posts including Public Health Expert, Admin. Support, Research Associate, Data Analyst / MIS Specialist, Hospital Management Expert, Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist, and Team Leader.
